scribe-gui-locked: Only one person can use the lectern at a time.
scribe-gui-edit-hint: This lectern is empty. Click Edit to add tasks or notes.
scribe-gui-save-failed: Your changes could not be saved — the lectern is no longer locked to you.
settings-completionpolicy-help: What happens to a pinned task when you check it off: keep it pinned (it sinks to the bottom of the HUD), unpin it, or delete the underlying task.
settings-hudcollapsed-help: Minimize the pinned-task HUD to just its header. Same as the HUD's collapse chevron and its toggle hotkey.
settings-hudanchor-help: Which screen corner or edge the pinned-task HUD is anchored to.
settings-hudmaxrows-help: How many pinned tasks the HUD shows at once (1–20). Extra pins are summarized as "+N more".
settings-hudrowwidth-help: The fixed pixel width of the HUD's task rows (100–1000, steps of 5); longer tasks wrap within this width.
settings-hudoffset-help: Nudge the HUD relative to its anchor's built-in position (e.g. clear of the minimap). Positive moves it toward screen center along each axis; clamped to ±300, steps of 5.
settings-hudfontscale-help: Scales the pinned-task HUD's text (80–120%, steps of 5). Applied on top of the game's Interface → GUI Scale.
settings-windowfontscale-help: Scales the text in Scribe's block windows (the lectern), 80–120%, steps of 5. Applied on top of the game's Interface → GUI Scale.
